HOUSING AND PUBLIC HEALTH COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 7, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 2:30 PM

Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, Chair
Daryl Supernaw, Vice Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online public comments and email
  comments to cityclerk@longbeach.gov

  Please view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone via:
  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54824  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Housing and Public Health
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, February 3, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54825  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Los Angeles County
  Affordable Housing Solutions Agency (LACAHSA) regarding the agency's
  foundational work, the unprecedented demand for the recent Notice of Funding
  Availability (NOFA), and the rollout of Measure A-funded initiatives.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54826  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion and potential action regarding
  future agenda items for the Housing and Public Health Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Housing and Public Health Committee on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
